# CoForge overlay (machine)

Load this once. Fetch detail on demand. Do not inline Carbon themes.json.

## Rules

- Git: `Coforge_skin`. Figma writes: `mnPFHuLUzXItWQimrWQEvV` (never `Ude8f8dEgXxxnpbzrvWfwE`).
- Overlay only. Do not edit `packages/themes/src/dtcg/themes.json`.
- No raw hex. Tokens: `palette.json`, `semantic-overrides.json`, Carbon `--cds-*`.
- Do not remap layer-01/02/03, field-*, border-subtle-*, syntax-*. Light only.
- Coral `#f15b40` = large primary fill only. Coral-text `#b03822` = links/labels. Small primary = ink or ghost.
- Query `component-token-map.json` before inventing. Missing row = proposal, not a primitive.

## Colour CSS

- `--cds-background` = bone `#eeece6`
- `--cds-text-primary` `--cds-icon-primary` `--cds-focus` `--cds-interactive` = ink `#041222`
- `--cds-button-primary` `--cds-background-brand` = coral `#f15b40`
- `--cds-link-primary` `--coforge-accent-text` = coral-text `#b03822`
